GE.source: CRRC Caucasus Barometer 2024 Georgia (national household survey), KNOWENG: self-rated English ability Intermediate 16% + Advanced 10%. Beginner (20%) excluded as below conversational. https://www.caucasusbarometer.org/en/cb2024ge/KNOWENG/

TK.source: Profile of Tokelau: 2016 Tokelau Census (Tokelau NSO / Stats NZ), p.26: 48.6% of usual residents could have a conversation in English. https://www.tokelau.org.nz/site/tokelau/files/TokelauNSO/2016Census/profile-tokelau-2016-census-final-to-print28jun17jj.pdf

CW.reason: 2011 census: most-spoken language only (English 3.1%); 2023 census: home language (3.8%). No ability question.

SX.reason: Only figure is 2001 census home/main language (67.5%).

JE.reason: 2021 census asked no language question (States Assembly WQ.28/2024); 94.6% figure is 2001 main language.

RS.reason: RZS 2022 AES gives English 52.8% as a share of reported foreign languages, not of adults. Eurostat AES (edat_aes_l51) gives only level among knowers.

AL.reason: Eurostat AES publishes only number of foreign languages known and level among knowers, not % knowing English.

FO.reason: 2011 census covers Faroese skills and first language only.

FK.reason: No published census language-ability table (2016 report link dead; 2021 none found). Factbook 89% is a 2006 estimate of unclear measure.

KG.reason: 2022 census asked other languages spoken fluently, but Book II Table 3.9 assigns one second language per person (English 38,166, ~0.55%), undercounting multilinguals.

BY.reason: 2019 census published native/home language; no English fluency figure found.

TJ.reason: 2020 census language volume not reachable; only a 2014 informal 5% estimate.

MD.reason: 2014 census: usual language only; English inside 0.5% 'other'.

TL.reason: 2022 census asks English literacy (read/write), not speaking, and main tables don't break it out.

MN.reason: No census figure; 2020 LFS covers literacy in any other language.

MV.reason: 2022 census measures English literacy, not speaking.

BI.reason: No English figure in 2008 census outputs.

KR.reason: No official survey; only a non-representative 2017 Job Korea poll and EF EPI (proficiency score).

MC.reason: IMSEE census covers nationality, not language.
